basis.reference: State machine and stale-import guards in src/components/atomic-crm/misc/usePapaParse.tsx
Test observable behavior for parsing, batch processing, progress, failures, and cancellation

risks.description: Hook does not transition parsing -> running -> complete correctly across batch boundaries.
risks.impact: Users receive wrong progress/completion feedback during CSV import.

risks.description: Batch failure path does not aggregate failed rows and continue with remaining batches.
risks.impact: Import metrics become inconsistent and downstream retry decisions are wrong.

risks.description: Fatal parser errors are not exposed in observable error state.
risks.impact: UI cannot surface a blocking CSV parse failure.

risks.description: Cancellation/reset allows stale async callbacks to mutate state.
risks.impact: Canceled imports can resume unexpectedly or apply obsolete callbacks.

scenarios.name: Tracks parsing, running progress and completion with deterministic batch timing
scenarios.preconditions: Hook mounted with batchSize=2 and processBatch promises controlled by deferred resolvers.
scenarios.stimulus: Trigger parseCsv and resolve two deferred batches in order after parser complete callback receives 3 rows.
scenarios.oracle: State sequence reaches parsing, running(rowCount=3, importCount=0), running(importCount=2, remainingTime=5), then complete(importCount=3, remainingTime=null).
scenarios.isolation: papaparse.parse mocked; Date.now mocked; no network or backend dependencies.

scenarios.name: Counts failed batch rows and continues with next batch
scenarios.preconditions: Hook mounted with two deferred batch promises and one parser warning.
scenarios.stimulus: Reject first batch promise, then resolve second batch promise.
scenarios.oracle: State reflects running(importCount=0,errorCount=3) after first rejection and complete(importCount=1,errorCount=3) after second batch.
scenarios.isolation: Deferred promises drive async deterministically without sleeps.

scenarios.name: Parser fatal error transitions to error state
scenarios.preconditions: Hook mounted and parse callback captured from papaparse mock.
scenarios.stimulus: Invoke parser error callback with Error('invalid csv stream').
scenarios.oracle: Latest observable importer state is error with matching message.
scenarios.isolation: No filesystem, browser navigation, or external service interaction.

scenarios.name: Reset during parsing ignores stale complete callback
scenarios.preconditions: Hook started parsing and reset is triggered before invoking captured complete callback.
scenarios.stimulus: Call reset then execute stale complete callback with non-empty rows.
scenarios.oracle: Latest state remains idle and processBatch is never called.
scenarios.isolation: Stale callback injected directly through mock parser options.

scenarios.name: Reset while first batch pending blocks stale running-loop continuation
scenarios.preconditions: First batch promise intentionally kept pending after entering running state.
scenarios.stimulus: Trigger reset while batch pending, then resolve stale pending promise.
scenarios.oracle: State stays idle after stale resolution and processBatch call count does not advance to a second batch.
scenarios.isolation: Deferred promise controls pending window deterministically.
